'''Murrwooro''' was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] from the [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] city of [[Rwookrrorro/Legends|Rwookrrorro]]. Around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], shortly after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] had ended, Murrwooro and their friend, [[Urrurrowo]], were severely injured when a large swarm of [[Flame beetle/Legends|flame beetles]] attacked them and exploded.<ref name="Kashyyyk in Flames" />
